title: Getting started with Acme Widgets
body: Welcome to Acme Widgets. Create a workspace, invite your team from Settings > Members, and connect your first data source. Most teams are set up in under an hour.

title: Billing FAQ
body: Plans renew monthly on the day you signed up. You can switch plans at any time from Settings > Billing, and changes are prorated. Invoices are emailed to the billing contact on file.

title: Resetting your password
body: Click 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page and enter your work email. The reset link expires after 30 minutes. If your workspace uses SSO, reset your password with your identity provider instead.

title: Creating and rotating API keys
body: Admins can create API keys from Settings > Developers. Give each integration its own key so you can revoke one without breaking the others. Rotate keys at least once a year, or right away if one leaks.

title: API rate limits
body: Each API key can make 100 requests per minute. When you go over, the API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Back off and retry after that many seconds.

title: Receiving webhooks
body: Add a webhook endpoint from Settings > Developers > Webhooks. Every event is signed with your endpoint secret, so verify the signature before trusting the payload. Failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff for up to 24 hours.

title: Exporting your data
body: Workspace owners can export everything as CSV or JSON from Settings > Data. Large exports run in the background and you'll get an email with a download link when it's ready.

title: Cancelling your account
body: You can cancel from Settings > Billing. Your workspace stays active until the end of the current billing period, and your data is kept for 30 days after that in case you change your mind.
